Limitation: Requires repository.require_signed_commits: true policy. Unsigned commits remain unverified if policy is disabled.
Requires Windows Administrator elevation (SeCreateGlobalPrivilege) for Kernel ETW trace session. Falls back to polling if unprivileged.
Monitors %TEMP% and user temp. Unconfigured directories or system folders require kernel minifilter driver (FLTMGR) or container isolation.
Encrypted DNS (DoH/DoT) over TCP/443 requires TLS interception or local DoH client endpoint provider.
